text: Every plan so far pointed here. Renata provisions law-oakmere-soc, the Log Analytics workspace, and enables Microsoft Sentinel directly on top of it.
Four data connectors get wired in: Entra ID sign-in and audit logs, Microsoft Defender XDR, Azure Activity, and AWS CloudTrail through Sentinel's S3 connector.
No detection rules get built yet. This lesson only confirms real data is actually landing in the workspace -- rows in SigninLogs, rows in AWSCloudTrail.
That distinction matters. A detection rule built against a connector that isn't actually ingesting data would pass every test and catch nothing real.
Next: writing the first Sentinel analytics rule against data that's now confirmed flowing in.
